magach6b.name: Magach 6B
magach6b.authority: Main ruled on 2026-10-31 that the Magach 6B takes stage A's photo route through this packet (the M60 batch, accepted for release 266 at 17fe8bb7d1). It is a release-266 build on the rebuilt M60A1's measured castings (profiles/pattonCast.ts) from the Yad la-Shiryon (Latrun) museum tank's photographs (the owner, 2026-10-28: "for the m60 new variants, lets add the: * Magach Series (Israel)"). Its latest shaded blind photo critic (round 18) scored 7/10, below the 8 pass mark; that round's items are the next round's work. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified: no owner model exists for this mark.
magach6b.envelopeBasis: As built (Box3 at both qualities, the photo check's rule). Width over the sprocket and idler hubs (the published M60A1's 3.63 m is over the tracks). Length from the stern plate to the M68's muzzle (the published M60A1's 9.44 m with the gun forward). Tallest is the tips of the two whip antennas on the bustle, as built rather than published; the body stands 3.31 m tall at its roof guns. docs/references/tanks/magach6b.md records the sources and the Latrun photographs.
